data.body:
[P2] Update the CI runner revision to include telemetry-2

The automatic workflow still pins `telemetry-suite.yml` to `0eaf7341…` and passes an empty `conformance_test_ref` on PR/push events. Its documented default therefore selects the existing pinned suite; merging the companion requirement PR will not advance it. The new failure handler will lack automated conformance coverage, while the local tests only check source/template wiring. Update `.github/workflows/telemetry-conformance-tests.yml` to select a revision containing `telemetry-2`, and verify that the per-PR report includes this requirement.
